key_insight: Capacity-aware online conformal risk control (CA-OCRC) extends long-term risk guarantees to settings with delayed feedback and limited capacity to track pending predictions.
engineering_relevance: CA-OCRC helps uncertainty-aware systems allocate scarce feedback-tracking resources while accounting for missing feedback when constructing prediction sets.
method: Sample a proxy delay to decide whether and how long to track each prediction.
Use inverse probability weighting to compensate for feedback lost through delays or capacity limits.
Optimize the proxy delay distribution using risk bounds and capacity scaling laws.
evidence_signal: Experiments span medical imaging, natural language processing, computer vision, and wireless communications, reporting effectiveness relative to existing OCRC mechanisms.
watch_item: Tracking-policy design must balance feedback collection against capacity saturation; the abstract provides no numerical capacity requirements or performance gains.
paper_title: Capacity-Constrained Delayed Feedback for Online Conformal Risk Control
